title: In a combat/interaction submenu opened via 'more here', selecting an item sometimes performed a different action than expected (e.g. picking a submenu entry at the Barrow Crypt caused an immediate 'go up' that exited the room instead of showing more combat options), forcing a re-entry to retry.
where: Barrow Crypt (early Vale barrow) / 'more here' submenus generally
